expectations.evidence: Defines --color-primary, --color-secondary, --color-surface etc. in theme.css under .theme-light/.theme-dark selectors. All components consume via var(--color-*).
Explicitly avoids ::ng-deep. Includes a comparison table showing why CSS custom properties are superior to ::ng-deep.
AppShellComponent uses host bindings [class.theme-light]='isLight()' and [class.theme-dark]='isDark()' driven by ThemeService signal.
Uses default ViewEncapsulation.Emulated throughout. Explains that CSS custom properties pierce emulated encapsulation because Angular's attribute rewriting doesn't affect var() resolution.
ThemeToggleComponent uses var(--color-outline), var(--color-surface-variant), etc. ProductCardComponent uses var(--color-surface-variant), var(--color-primary), var(--color-on-primary) extensively.
